name: Fourier Analysis
description: Fourier series - definition, uniqueness, convolution, summability, convergence of Fourier series, Fourier series for square integrable functions, Plancheral theorem, Riesz-Fischer theorem, Dini’s condition, divergence of Fourier series. Fourier transform – Schwartz space on R^n, Fourier transform on the Schwartz space, Fourier transform of L1 functions, Schwartz class, Fourier transform for L2 functions, Plancherel theorem. Tempered distributions- topology on the Schwartz space, tempered distributions and its properties, Fourier transform of tempered distributions. Hardy-Littlewood maximal function- approximations of the identity, weak-type in-equality, Marcinkiewicz interpolation theorem, Hardy-Littlewood maximal function and its properties, Calderon-Zygmund theorem, Riesz-Thorin interpolation theorem. The Hilbert transform: conjugate Poisson kernel, principal value distribution, Riesz and Kolmogorov theorems, multipliers.
